rationale: The final three 1-minute candles printed higher highs, higher lows and rising volume, culminating in the largest range candle of the sequence that carried price through the 9-EMA at 40.51 and lifted it 1.25% off the session low on 3.75× relative volume. Price sits at 36% of the day’s range, still below VWAP, so the long thesis is that the visible buying pressure continues toward at least a retest of the 41.39 high; a break of the 40.17 swing low formed by the recent consolidation invalidates the setup.
